command:
set -e
fake=$(mktemp -d)
printf "%s\n" "#!/bin/sh" "printf %s \"not a url\"" > "$fake/pbpaste"
chmod +x "$fake/pbpaste"
cd /tmp
set +e
out=$(PATH="$fake:$PATH" chatmd 2>&1)
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$out"
test "$status" -eq 2
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -q "clipboard is not a URL"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "CAPTURE COMPLETE"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "Saved:"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "Shared source:"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "This shared link still exists."

set -e
fake=$(mktemp -d)
printf "%s\n" "#!/bin/sh" "echo CLIPBOARD_SHOULD_NOT_BE_READ >&2" "exit 99" > "$fake/pbpaste"
chmod +x "$fake/pbpaste"
cd /tmp
set +e
out=$(PATH="$fake:$PATH" chatmd not-a-url 2>&1)
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$out"
test "$status" -eq 2
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -q "expected an absolute HTTP(S) share URL"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "CLIPBOARD_SHOULD_NOT_BE_READ"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "pbpaste"

set -e
fake=$(mktemp -d)
printf "%s\n" "#!/bin/sh" "printf %s \"   \n  \"" > "$fake/pbpaste"
chmod +x "$fake/pbpaste"
cd /tmp
set +e
out=$(PATH="$fake:$PATH" chatmd 2>&1)
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$out"
test "$status" -eq 2
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -q "clipboard is empty"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "CAPTURE COMPLETE"

set -e
fake=$(mktemp -d)
printf "%s\n" "#!/bin/sh" "printf %s \"https://example.com/share/example\"" > "$fake/pbpaste"
chmod +x "$fake/pbpaste"
cd /tmp
set +e
out=$(PATH="$fake:$PATH" chatmd 2>&1)
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$out"
test "$status" -eq 2
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -q "clipboard is not a ChatGPT share URL"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "CAPTURE COMPLETE"

set -e
fake=$(mktemp -d)
# no pbpaste in PATH
cd /tmp
set +e
out=$(PATH="$fake" chatmd 2>&1)
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$out"
test "$status" -eq 2
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -q "pbpaste is unavailable"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "CAPTURE COMPLETE"

set -e
fake=$(mktemp -d)
printf "%s\n" "#!/bin/sh" "echo '   '" > "$fake/pbpaste"
chmod +x "$fake/pbpaste"
cd /tmp
set +e
out=$(PATH="$fake:$PATH" chatmd 2>&1)
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$out"
test "$status" -eq 2
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -q "clipboard is empty"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "CAPTURE COMPLETE"

set -e
chatmd_bin=$(command -v chatmd)
empty=$(mktemp -d)
cd /tmp
set +e
out=$(PATH="$empty" "$chatmd_bin" 2>&1)
status=$?
set -e
printf "%s\n" "$out"
test "$status" -eq 2
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -q "pbpaste is unavailable"
printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -qv "CAPTURE COMPLETE"
